# Verification Report — `vea-validator2` (retry_rpc doc comment task)

## Verdict: **NEEDS-CHANGES**

The actual deliverable — the doc comment on `retry_rpc` — is **accurate, correct, and well-written**. However, the change **sprawls far beyond the requested single-function doc comment**: 13 additional files were reformatted (1,615 insertions / 408 deletions), the tree is left half-formatted (`cargo fmt --check` still fails), and a stray 4,793-line `.fmt-churn.patch` is left untracked. The diff should be narrowed to just the `src/lib.rs` doc comment before merge.

## Findings

### P1 — Scope sprawl: 14 files changed instead of one (formatting-only, but out of scope)
`src/config.rs`, `src/epoch_watcher.rs`, `src/indexer.rs`, `src/main.rs`, `src/startup.rs`, and 7 test files are all reformatted (import reordering, line wrapping, argument reflow). The task was: *"Add a doc comment to the public retry_rpc function in src/lib.rs … Do NOT change any logic or behavior."* I verified via manual review of every hunk that the extra changes are **pure rustfmt churn with no logic/behavior change** — but they are still unrequested edits to 13 files beyond the target, making a ~16-line task into a ~2,000-line diff. **Recommended fix: revert everything except the `src/lib.rs` doc-comment hunk.**

### P2 — Half-formatted tree: `cargo fmt --check` fails
The reformatting is internally inconsistent. `cargo fmt --check` still reports diffs in `src/finality.rs` and all of `src/tasks/*.rs` (challenge, claim, dispatcher, execute_relay, mod, save_snapshot, send_snapshot, start_verification, validate_claim, verify_snapshot, withdraw_deposit). So the repo was not fmt-clean at HEAD, and the partial pass leaves it in a mixed state — worse than either "don't format" or "format everything".
